questions.question: What is the minimum lighting on the part surface when PT is conducted under the daylight?
questions.korean: 일광하에서 침투 탐상 시험시 최소 밝기는 얼마인가?

questions.question: 1/16" linear indication found on welds. Is this acceptable?
questions.korean: 용접부에서 1/16인치의 선형지시가 발견되었다. 이 결함은 합격인가?

questions.question: 5/16" round indication found on welds. Is this acceptable?
questions.korean: 용접부에서 5/16인치 원형지시가 발견되었다. 이것은 합격인가?

questions.question: When using solvent removable penetrants, flushing the surface with solvent to remove excess penetrant is prohibited. Why?
questions.korean: Solvent removable 침투액 사용 시 과잉 침투액 제거를 위해 솔벤트를 표면에 쏟는 것을 금지하는 이유는?
options: Because penetrant can be removed from the discontinuity
Because solvent cannot clean the surface

questions.question: How is the penetrant applied?
questions.korean: 침투액의 적용방법은?

questions.question: What is the minimum drying time of solvent cleaning?
questions.korean: 솔벤트 세척의 최소 건조시간은?

questions.question: What is the minimum and maximum time permitted for development prior to final interpretation?
questions.korean: 최종 판정 전 현상 시간의 최소 및 최대 시간은?

questions.question: Which discontinuity would not be detectable by liquid penetrant examination?
questions.korean: 침투탐상검사로 검출할 수 없는 불연속은?

questions.question: Black light with proper functioning filter used for fluorescent PT can cause permanent damage to:
questions.korean: 형광침투탐상검사의 자외선등이 영구 손상을 줄 수 있는 것은?

questions.question: The surface of PSL2 quality grade product is inspected by PT. A round indication of 1/4in.(6mm) appeared. Is it acceptable?
questions.korean: PSL2 제품 표면 PT 검사에서 1/4인치(6mm) 원형지시가 나타났다. 합격인가?

questions.question: When inspecting quality grade PSL2 products with a weld depth of 3/4 in.(19 mm) by PT, a round indication of 1/4in.(6mm) appeared. Is it acceptable?
questions.korean: 용접부 깊이가 19mm인 PSL2 제품 PT 검사에서 1/4인치(6mm) 원형지시가 나타났다. 합격인가?

questions.question: A 2in. thick weld with 2mm outside reinforcement is examined by liquid penetrant method according to ASME Sec.III NB-5000. Which is acceptable indication?
questions.korean: 두께 2인치, 외부 용접덧살 2mm인 용접부를 ASME Sec.III NB-5000에 따라 PT 검사할 때 합격 가능한 지시는?
options: 2/16in. dimension - four rounded indications in a line separated by 1/16in.
1/32in. dimension - ten rounded indications in a line separated by 1/16in.

questions.question: This procedure describes the Liquid penetrant testing for ______.
questions.korean: 본 절차서는 ______을 위한 침투탐상 방법을 기술한다.

questions.question: Acceptance standard shall be used ______.
questions.korean: 합격기준은 ______을 따른다.

questions.question: Visible light at the surface of the part should be minimum ______.
questions.korean: 제품 표면에서 빛의 세기는 최소 ______이다.

questions.question: The surface to be examined and all adjacent areas within at least ____ shall be dry and free of scale, grease, etc.
questions.korean: 시험할 표면과 인접 지역은 최소 ____까지 스케일, 그리스 등이 없어야 한다.

questions.question: The minimum penetration time shall be ____ for temperature range 10~50℃.
questions.korean: 온도범위 10~50℃에서 최소 침투 시간은?

questions.question: Rounded indications in weld: (3ea) 1/16in., (3ea) 7/64in., and (4ea) 1/8in. indications separated by 1/16in. Is the weld acceptable?
questions.korean: 용접부에 원형지시가 나타났다. 이 용접부는 합격인가?

questions.question: A length 1/8in.(3mm) rounded indication is found. Is this indication acceptable?
questions.korean: 길이 1/8인치(3mm)의 원형지시는 합격인가?

questions.question: Only 5/32" rounded indication was found on forgings of which thickness is 1". Is it acceptable?
questions.korean: 두께 1인치 단조품에서 5/32인치 원형지시가 발견되었다. 합격인가?

questions.question: When doing liquid penetrant examination on weld edge preparation, 3/4" laminar type discontinuities are found. Is this acceptable?
questions.korean: 용접 개선 부위 PT 검사에서 3/4인치 라미나 형태 불연속이 발견되었다. 합격인가?

questions.question: In Fig.1, A is acceptable. (Ref.: Sect.III subsect.NB)
questions.korean: 그림 1에서 결함 A는 합격이다.

questions.question: Which of the following discontinuities could be classified as a servicing discontinuity?
questions.korean: 다음 불연속 중 가동 중 결함으로 분류할 수 있는 것은?

questions.question: For precleaning, this procedure states;
questions.korean: 전처리에 대해 올바른 것은?
options: 1 inch adjacent to the area to be examined shall be clean
1/2 inch adjacent to the area to be examined shall be clean
A light coating of oil on the test surface is acceptable

questions.question: Surface preparation before liquid penetrant examination shot or sand blasting can be used.
questions.korean: 액체침투탐상 검사 전 표면처리로 숏 또는 샌드 블라스팅을 사용할 수 있다.
